---
name: rank-tracking-getting-started
description: >-
  Use this as the first conversation with a new owner of the Amazon
  rank-tracking bot.
---
## 1. Introduce yourself with the heatmap preview
First download the preview image to your own computer:
`mkdir -p /workspace/intro && curl -fsSL -o /workspace/intro/heatmap-preview.png https://raw.githubusercontent.com/pnguyennhatha-ux/rankflow-template/main/docs/heatmap-preview.png`

Then send ONE message to the owner, with the image attached in the same bubble (SendToUser `images: [{"url": "file:///workspace/intro/heatmap-preview.png", "alt": "Rank heatmap by ASIN x keyword in Lark"}]`). Never paste the image as markdown. If the download fails, send the text alone and include the raw.githubusercontent.com link as a markdown link.

Intro text (translate to the owner's language if it isn't Vietnamese, and keep the meaning):

**Theo dõi thứ hạng organic trên Amazon cho hàng loạt từ khóa, tự chạy theo lịch, hiện thành heatmap ngay trong Lark.**

Bạn chạy ads xong, rank organic có lên không? Bot này trả lời câu đó mỗi ngày mà không cần ai ngồi gõ từ khóa.

Em sẽ setup trọn hệ thống cho bạn:
- Nhập ASIN và nhóm từ khóa một lần, crawl tự chạy theo lịch (Amazon US, ZIP 10001, sâu tới 190 kết quả organic).
- Kết quả đồng bộ về Lark Base dưới dạng heatmap theo từng ngày. Xanh là top, vàng là đang trượt, xám là không thấy. Bấm vào một ô sẽ thấy biểu đồ rank và giá theo thời gian.
- Checker và team ads nhìn một bảng là biết từ khóa nào đang ăn, từ khóa nào cần đẩy thêm hoặc cắt bớt.

Em làm từng bước: tạo Lark app, Base, block heatmap, backend và extension crawl. Bước nào ghi dữ liệu hay chạy thật em đều hỏi trước. Không bao giờ bịa rank: gặp CAPTCHA hay kết quả không chắc thì em ghi là chưa xác minh.

Bắt đầu bằng 1 ASIN và 3–4 từ khóa nhé.

## 2. Setup questions, one at a time, in the owner's language
1. What should I call you, and which language do you want me to reply in?
2. Should I use the public template repo, or do you have your own fork? (A private fork needs a GitHub login, which I'll start for you.)
3. Do you already have a Lark app and Base, or should we create them? (The App Secret only goes in through a secret request, never in chat.)
4. Which marketplace and ZIP should I crawl, and how deep? (Default is Amazon US, ZIP 10001, 190 organic results.)
5. Give me one test ASIN and 3-4 keywords for the first run.

## 3. Then
Save the answers as memories, then follow the rankflow-setup-from-repo skill step by step. Ask before any Base write, live crawl, or Chrome launch.

---
name: rankflow-setup-from-repo

  Use this when setting up an Amazon keyword-rank tracking system (Lark Base +
  heatmap block + backend + Chrome extension) for a new user from zero, starting
  from the public rankflow-template GitHub repo.
---
# Set up rank tracking from the template repo

Source of truth: the public repo https://github.com/pnguyennhatha-ux/rankflow-template.git, or the user's own fork if they give one.

## 1. Get clean source
1. Clone without logging in: `git clone https://github.com/pnguyennhatha-ux/rankflow-template.git /workspace/projects/<user-slug>-rankflow`. Use a fresh folder for each user, and never reuse or edit another project folder.
2. Only if the user uses a private fork: check `gh auth status`. If it isn't logged in, run `gh auth login -h github.com -p https -w -s repo` in the background, send the user the one-time code with https://github.com/login/device, then run `gh auth setup-git`.
3. Pick a free port before serving: check `ss -ltnp` and never take a port that is already in use.
4. To update later, run `git pull` in that folder. Never overwrite the local `.env` or data.

## 2. Check the clone before touching Lark
- `python3 -m unittest discover -s backend` should pass.
- In `extension/`, run `npm ci`, `npx vitest run`, then `npx wxt build`.
- In `block-ui/`, run `npm ci` and the typecheck/build scripts from `package.json`. If the typecheck fails, tell the user the errors before uploading anything.

## 3. Follow SETUP.md in the clone, in order
1. Lark app: the user creates it in the Developer Console and gives you the App ID. The App Secret comes only through a secret request, never pasted in chat. Set the scopes and contact range, then publish an app version.
2. lark-cli: install it and run `auth login` as the user (needed for full member sync). Note when the refresh token expires and offer a reminder routine to renew it.
3. Base: create one or reuse the user's. Run `backend/rankflow.py schema` as a dry-run plan first, and create tables only after the user approves.
4. Block: the user creates the block and gives you the Block ID. Fill `block-ui/.env`, build, and upload with opdev. The user publishes it and shares the Base with Can edit, because view-only causes error B4.
5. Backend: copy `.env.example` to `.env`, keep `RANKFLOW_LIVE_ENABLED=0`, and serve in the background on the free port.
6. Extension: load the built extension unpacked in Chrome on your own desktop, after the user approves. Keep one Chrome window only.
7. Acceptance: run 1 ASIN with 3-4 keywords while live is off and check the results. Then turn live on, with approval.

## Rules
- Never print secrets or tokens, and never expose member emails.
- No Base writes, no live crawl, and no Chrome launch without the user's go-ahead for each one.
- Never invent a rank. CAPTCHA or uncertain results stay unverified.
- Defaults: Amazon US, ZIP 10001, depth 190 organic, 2 batches.
- Watch the pitfalls in SETUP.md: URL fields need {text, link}, and the contact range limits member sync.
